verdict.rationale: LiveKit's docs claim an Agent Builder that lets you prototype and deploy voice agents in the browser without writing code, which covers the no-code, visual-builder part of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows that this builder supports multi-step flows, branching, state management or agent handoffs, and the rest of the evidence describes a code-first Python/Node.js framework. Missing for 10: documented visual branching/flow design, states, handoffs between agents in the builder, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of the builder.
